- Time: 60 min (Essential) / 90 min (Expanded) / 120 min (Full Workshop)
- Focus: World Fashion
- Materials: vocabulary cards, audio, reading handout
Warm-up: say one word you already know for this topic.

Which word belongs to this topic?
Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

fashion — the style of clothes at a time. Example: She works in fashion.
style — a way of dressing or doing things. Example: I like your style.
wear — to have clothes on your body. Example: She wears a jacket in winter.
dress — a woman's one-piece garment, or to put clothes on. Example: The model is wearing a long dress.
shirt — a garment for the upper body. Example: He is wearing a white shirt.
shoes — things you wear on your feet. Example: These shoes are new.
jacket — a short coat. Example: She is wearing a black jacket.
trendy — very fashionable now. Example: That bag is very trendy.
model — a person who shows clothes. Example: The model is on the catwalk.
designer — a person who creates clothes. Example: A designer is talking about colour.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• What is she wearing?
• She is wearing ...
• It is very trendy.
• I like your style.
• These shoes are new.
Vocabulary practice: choose the correct word.
Which word means 'the style of clothes at a time'?
Which word means 'a way of dressing or doing things'?
Complete the sentence with a word from the list.
wear is /weə/ and wearing is /ˈweərɪŋ/.
She is WEAring a jacket.
Listen and repeat three times.
Which word carries the main stress?
Grammar focus: Present continuous: is wearing.
Use the present continuous for clothes worn now: She is wearing a red jacket. Question: What is he wearing?
Controlled practice: choose the correct option.
Choose the correct sentence.
What ___ he wearing?
Complete the sentence.
Reading: read the text and answer the questions.
The model is wearing a long dress and black shoes. Her jacket is trendy. A designer is talking about style and colour.
Listening: listen to the dialogue and answer the questions.
A: What is she wearing? B: She is wearing a white shirt and a black jacket. A: Are the shoes new? B: Yes, they are very trendy.
Speaking: Pair and group tasks: Describe photos of outfits and say what you like or dislike.

• What is she wearing?
• She is wearing ...
• It is very trendy.
Writing: Write four to five sentences about "World Fashion" using the target grammar.
